Our flagship insurance case study, Xenera, is a risk-reduction AI system built for a global insurance carrier — a working example of what a Keytechx engagement looks like end-to-end. AI isn't a layer we add on top — it's embedded in how we build. Across active client work we've shipped RAG document systems, agentic workflow tools, a lightweight local LLM coding assistant, and AI knowledge bases. The same thinking runs through our own delivery process. From requirements analysis and task breakdown to code review and deployment, AI sits inside each step — not bolted on at the end.
